title: Distributed Systems 1.1: Introduction
summary: The first lecture in Martin Kleppmann's 8-lecture distributed systems series from the University of Cambridge undergraduate course. It introduces the subject, and accompanying lecture notes are available.
why: HN regularly recommends the series as a free, accessible, theory-oriented course on distributed computing that complements his book Designing Data-Intensive Applications.

quote.text: the distributed system audio course on youtube is extremely accessible
